address: 102-3 Guanghua Street, North District, Hsinchu City, Taiwan
bio: The owner is passionate about art and gardening, hence the murals (which she hand-painted herself) and profusion of lush greenery in her cosy, homespun joint. The head chef has been cooking professionally for over 40 years and his eight-course set menu is the quintessence of Taiwanese home-style cooking. Seasoning is on the light side so the ingredients can shout their name. The friendly service and a buzzy vibe keep diners coming back.
